operations.summary: Reads account row then updates email and rewrites plan from the read value (read-modify-write).
Directly updates plan and plan_changed_by for one account.

conflicts.risk_explanation: v1 does SELECT plan then UPDATE email,plan with the stale read value. Concurrent v2 UPDATE to plan is overwritten when v1 commits second (lost update). Final plan reverts to stale value while plan_changed_by still shows v2 actor, leaving inconsistent row.

tests.name: concurrent_email_and_plan_change_loses_plan
tests.rationale: Old release rewrites plan from a stale SELECT while new release updates plan concurrently on same row. Whichever order commits, correct code would end with new email and new plan; buggy v1 second loses the plan update.

invariants.description: email change must survive concurrent plan change
plan change must not be lost by stale rewrite from email change
plan_changed_by must reflect the plan writer

tests.name: email_race_with_two_plan_changes
tests.rationale: Three-way race increases interleavings where v1 SELECTs free before either plan commits then rewrites free last, wiping out both plan updates. Correct code would preserve email and leave plan as one of pro/team.

invariants.description: email update must survive regardless of plan interleaving
final plan must be one of the two concurrent new plans, never stale free
final actor must be one of the two plan writers
